reviews.author: Mia Derstine
reviews.text: Traveling to Scotland, and there comes a time when the next meal MUST be Asian noodles or I’ll die. I’m fairly picky about ramen so it’s always a gamble, but this place was great. Got the chicken ramen with a very mildly spiced miso broth. Broth was tasty, but not too rich - I literally finished the entire bowl. Noodles were really interesting, in a good way. They weren’t a classic alkaline springy ramen, BUT they had a nice al dente texture that almost reminded me of soba. Nothing breaks ramen like a soggy sad noodle, and I’m happy to report these noodles passed the test! Service was fast and friendly. Apps were good. And reading everyone’s sticky notes and doodles on the walls was really cute. I’d definitely go back!

reviews.text: Came here with my son. Ordered goyoza, ramen chicken/noodle dish and green dragon roll. I then asked for a lychee juice (something I have everytime I visit your aberdeen store), server didn't know and would have to check. My sons ramen came and it was missing the pork and I never got a drink to have with my food, not by choice. When we asked for containers to take the food home they didn't bring enough and we had to ask for one more for my sons ramen. We didnt get a bag, we were not offered so as we were carrying out 4 containers of food someone not in uniform asked us if we would like a bag. If this had been my first experience in a maki and ramen I would not hurry back. But within the last 7 days I have been to your aberdeen store, here everything is exceptional especially the staff and service. I have also visited your Leith store, which was good. We were told the visit today was below par because the staff were new!

reviews.author: Jasmine Patel
reviews.text: My partner and I were really excited to try this new ramen spot out, however we were disappointed with our experience. When ordering drinks, we were told they hadn't got any coke in stock and it just got worse from there really.. the ramen lacked flavour, the broth tasted powdery, the boiled egg was stone cold and the noodles were stiff. The whole dish tasted cheap - nothing authentic about it and nothing compared to the real thing in Japan. Sorry, I would not recommend this place!

reviews.author: Mat
reviews.text: I've never had sushi with this much DRAMA!! I got the new omakase set at maki nori Soho and chef Teddy Lee brought out the theatrics with smoke, fire, dry ice, caviar bumps and even a huge dry aged salmon. Omakase means "I'll leave it up to you" so it's chef's choice based on ingredients and seasonality. The 6th Sep menu: 1. Akami Crudo 2. Scallop Crudo ⭐ 3. Salmon Nigiri 4. Sea bream nigiri 5. Smoked hamachi nigiri ⭐ 6. Wagyu nigiri ⭐ 7. Caviar tequila bump 8. Negitoro hand roll ⭐ 9. Spicy tuna hand roll 10. Eel and Foie Gras hand roll ⭐ 11. Miso soup 12. Cheese tart ❌ Highlights for me include the scallop crudo which paired really well with the sweet orange; the wagyu nigiri which was so tender and almost melted in the mouth and the eel foie gras hand roll (I've never had this before!) which was so unique and the way the buttery fois gras just melted was insane. Whilst it does have you wanting MORE, overall this is a fairly priced omakase experience, when you consider the lovely ambience, minimalist interiors and playful theatrical aspects.

reviews.author: スカイ
reviews.text: Saw it in development so I was really exited to try when they finally opened. The amount of genuine care is incredible, from food to service I thoroughly enjoyed everything. I only wish the portion was a bit bigger but overall a really nice place to get your sushi fix.

reviews.author: Bayan A
reviews.text: Amazing sushi , tried the hand roll hamachi and it tasted perfect, good quality tuna and salmon and most importantly as per manager all halal and no alcohol used in making the rice or soya , if u like authentic sushi then thats ur place
